name: decodo
description: Scrape web pages, search the web, crawl whole sites, and pull structured results from search engines, eCommerce platforms and social media with Decodo's Web Data API.

interface.shortDescription: Live web data for your chats
interface.longDescription: Scrape any web page as Markdown or a screenshot, search the web, crawl and map entire sites, and pull structured results from Google, Bing, Amazon, Walmart, Target, TikTok, YouTube, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Requests run through Decodo's Web Data API, which handles JavaScript rendering, proxy rotation and anti-bot systems, with geo-targeting across 195+ locations. Requires a Decodo account; each request uses your Web Data API plan.
capabilities: Scrape web pages as Markdown or screenshots
Scrape Google and Bing search results
defaultPrompt: Scrape decodo.com from a US IP and summarize the pricing.
Search the web for MCP server hosting options.
Find wireless keyboards on Amazon and compare the top three.

positive.prompt: Scrape https://decodo.com/scraping/web and list the plans it mentions.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page content and lists the plans named on it.

positive.prompt: Search the web for MCP server hosting options.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ranked web results with titles and links.

positive.description: Scrape Google Search from a location
positive.prompt: Search Google for running shoes from Germany and tell me the top result.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns parsed German Google results and names the top organic result.

positive.prompt: Find wireless keyboards on Amazon and compare the top three.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Amazon listings and compares price and rating of the first three.

positive.prompt: Take a screenshot of github.com from a US IP address.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a PNG screenshot of the github.com home page.

negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest wireless keyboard on Amazon for me.
